provenance_references.package_manager_version_metadata: unavailable in the DEMO-02 evidence; exact package release not established
provenance_references.inventory_scoped_assessment: The reviewed installed notice and upstream files describe permissive CMU software/voice licensing; no separate restriction on newly synthesized output was found in those reviewed sources. Scoped provenance review only, not legal advice or an exclusivity claim.

generated_speech.redistribution_boundary: Only generated PCM/WAV output is in the project. Flite software and CMU voice binaries are not copied into the repository; software/voice binary obligations should be revisited if those binaries are ever redistributed.
generated_speech.ffmpeg_boundary: FFmpeg 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 was a local generation tool, not included. The pinned FFmpeg binary/package license/build-configuration record is absent; do not claim its binary redistribution has been cleared.

evidence_gaps: requirements/dev.lock and requirements/runtime.lock pin versions but contain no wheel hashes; the installed environment comparison verifies metadata/version closure, not exact wheel bytes across platforms.
package-lock.json pins TypeScript 5.8.3 and records its registry tarball URL but omits npm integrity; exact tarball bytes are therefore not fixed by the frozen lock.

Several Python packages use legacy or generic license metadata rather than an SPDX expression. Their exact included license files are listed; annotated-types and click lack a METADATA License/License-Expression field, packaging has only generic Apache/BSD classifiers, and pyasn1-modules declares only generic BSD.
pluggy has no upstream project/repository URL in its installed METADATA; its source column falls back to the PyPI project/release page.

pip and setuptools are development/build-only pins whose distributions contain bundled vendored components and per-component notices. These notices are present in the local installed metadata, not expanded as 46 additional top-level locks; preserve and review them if redistributing those tool distributions/environments.

No consolidated third-party NOTICE/license bundle for the Python dependency set is present in the checked source tree. Applicability depends on what a future distribution actually bundles; this inventory is not itself a redistribution bundle.

MIRA project-wide license remains unspecified. The project-authorship notes are provenance claims, not an independent originality assessment or a license selection for the project/AI-assisted art/captions.

DEMO-02 records no Flite package-manager metadata; FFmpeg and Flite/voice binary redistribution evidence is incomplete because those binaries are not included and were not assessed for redistribution.
No legal clearance or license conclusion for the whole project is made.

source_tree_drift.note: Observed source file hash differs from the inventory hash. The recorded inventory hash is for the whole apps/web/index.html container, not a separately computed SVG-fragment hash; re-review the modified file before relying on this provenance record.

interpretation_limits: This is a copied-text and provenance manifest, not a project-license choice, legal advice, or legal clearance.
The source tree currently contains dependency declarations and project assets, not the installed Python or TypeScript package implementations. Actual obligations depend on the exact release contents.
Preserve each copied text in its package-specific directory. Do not infer a missing SPDX expression or convert generic/legacy license metadata into a stronger statement.
